item.title: Version 0.1.12
item.description:
RunBar reads your last four weeks and proposes a weekly target you can actually hold — and ships an optional AI coach for two-line check-ins.
• Weekly target suggestions. Each Monday RunBar evaluates your last four ISO weeks and proposes a fresh target. Capped at +20% per week. Suggests a more realistic lower target if you've been below 70% for two weeks running. • Quick target edit. Click the 'of XX km' label in the popover for a menu with ±2 / ±5 km shortcuts and a path to Settings. • Optional AI coach. Bring your own API key (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite by default — free tier covers daily use). Two-to-four lines, factual and warm, only based on real facts from your week. Disabled until you connect it. • Onboarding. New optional step lets you paste a Gemini key during first launch (skippable). • Privacy. The AI coach only sees weekly aggregates — distance, runs, elevation, target, progress, days left, four-week distance history, streak, race countdown. Never activity names, timestamps, or GPS data.
